text.autoconfig.geogradient.title: GeoGradient
geogradient.configuration.title: GeoGradient
geogradient.configuration.climate.toolti: Every change here affects newly generated chunks only.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.globe: Distance in blocks from a pole to the nearest equator. Spawn (Z = 0) sits halfway, at latitude 45 degrees, and the climate repeats every 2 x Globe Size blocks.
geogradient.configuration.globe_size.too: Distance in blocks from a pole to the nearest equator. Spawn (Z = 0) sits halfway, at latitude 45 degrees, and the climate repeats every 2 x Globe Size blocks.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.spawn: Moves the world spawn the first time a world loads. 0.0 leaves it at Z = 0 (latitude 45 degrees); -1.0 moves it to the equator and 1.0 to the north pole.
geogradient.configuration.spawn_latitude: Moves the world spawn the first time a world loads. 0.0 leaves it at Z = 0 (latitude 45 degrees); -1.0 moves it to the equator and 1.0 to the north pole.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.borde: How far band borders wander north and south, in blocks. 0 makes every border a straight line.
geogradient.configuration.border_amplitu: How far band borders wander north and south, in blocks. 0 makes every border a straight line.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.borde: How tightly band borders wiggle. Lower values give long, gentle curves; higher values give short ripples.
geogradient.configuration.border_frequen: How tightly band borders wiggle. Lower values give long, gentle curves; higher values give short ripples.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.blend: Width of the gradual change between neighboring bands, as a fraction of the narrower band. 0.0 switches climate at a hard line.
geogradient.configuration.blend_fraction: Width of the gradual change between neighboring bands, as a fraction of the narrower band. 0.0 switches climate at a hard line.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.tempe: How much of vanilla's temperature noise is added to each band. 0.0 gives every band one temperature; higher values mix in neighboring biomes.
geogradient.configuration.temperature_va: How much of vanilla's temperature noise is added to each band. 0.0 gives every band one temperature; higher values mix in neighboring biomes.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.humid: How much of vanilla's humidity noise is added to each band. 0.0 gives every band one humidity; higher values mix wetter and drier biomes.
geogradient.configuration.humidity_varia: How much of vanilla's humidity noise is added to each band. 0.0 gives every band one humidity; higher values mix wetter and drier biomes.
geogradient.configuration.bands.tooltip: The seven climate bands, equator to pole.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.bands: Latitude in degrees where this band ends and the next band toward the pole begins (0 = equator, 90 = pole).
Temperature at this band's center, -1.0 to 1.0: below -0.45 frozen, to -0.15 cold, to 0.2 temperate, to 0.55 warm, above that hot.
Humidity at this band's center, -1.0 to 1.0: below -0.35 arid, to -0.1 dry, to 0.1 neutral, to 0.3 wet, above that humid.

geogradient.configuration.features.toolt: Extras GeoGradient adds beside the climate itself.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.featu: Adds a line to the F3 debug screen with the climate, band and distances to each pole and the equator where you stand.
geogradient.configuration.show_debug_lin: Adds a line to the F3 debug screen with the climate, band and distances to each pole and the equator where you stand.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.featu: When TerraBlender is installed, picks each biome through its regions so biome mods built on it keep their biomes. Off uses vanilla's biome lookup.
geogradient.configuration.use_terrablend: When TerraBlender is installed, picks each biome through its regions so biome mods built on it keep their biomes. Off uses vanilla's biome lookup.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.featu: Registers /geogradient info, which reports the climate at your position or at given coordinates. Takes effect when a world loads.
geogradient.configuration.enable_command: Registers /geogradient info, which reports the climate at your position or at given coordinates. Takes effect when a world loads.
text.autoconfig.geogradient.option.featu: Once per game start, checks alkeari.com for a newer GeoGradient for your Minecraft version and loader and says so in chat only when one is out. Nothing else is sent. Takes effect at the next start.
geogradient.configuration.check_for_upda: Once per game start, checks alkeari.com for a newer GeoGradient for your Minecraft version and loader and says so in chat only when one is out. Nothing else is sent. Takes effect at the next start.
